method_parameters.source: iCaRL fixed-memory protocol under the 2000-sample cap

protocol.technical_input_conversion: raw binary [T,C] -> [C,T] persistence view -> runtime RGB 160x160 at model boundary
protocol.spike_replay_persistence: selected samples are stored as true 1-bit packed arrays; uint8/float32 tensors exist only while replay is materialized
protocol.spike_replay_label_persistence: uint8 one-hot using one byte per class entry
protocol.flop_convention: 1 MAC = 2 FLOPs; no post-hoc doubling of PyTorch 2.11 totals
